reason: schema evidence approval-payload lists EVIDENCE_SCENARIO_NOT_INDEXED; add and audit no longer do; schema_codes test maps it
summary: [standards] EVIDENCE_SCENARIO_NOT_INDEXED is filed under the wrong commands in the schema. `canon schema evidence approval-payload --json` lists errorCodes without it, even though that leaf is the only one that emits it and its own exit row names it. `evidence add` and `evidence audit` list it but never emit it. The cause: the error is built in evidence.rs with no `emit("canon evidence approval-payload")` nearby, so the code-table generator falls back to the file default. The schema-codes test compares the table with the same derivation, so it stays green. Fix: build the CliError at the approval-payload emit site, or map it explicitly; re-bless schema_codes and regenerate docs/cli/canon.cli.json.
